rows.en: ; Values are ignored if there is a space between "=" and the value.
; Lines starting with ";" are comments.
; Camera behaviour parameters.
; Basic tuning is done with the following parameters:
;	EYE_X		Offset of the eye (camera) X coordinate.
;	EYE_Y		Offset of the eye (camera) Y coordinate.
;	EYE_Z		Offset of the eye (camera) Z coordinate.
;	TARGET_X	Offset of the look-at point X coordinate.
;	TARGET_Y	Offset of the look-at point Y coordinate.
;	TARGET_Z	Offset of the look-at point Z coordinate.
;	ROLL		Rotation offset (degrees).
;	RATE		Interpolation rate.
; Fighter mode (not locked on).
; The offset is computed from the unit's tilt.
; It is computed within the FIGHTER_PITCH_RANGE and FIGHTER_ROLL_RANGE
; set in [BEHAVIOR_PARAM].
; With FIGHTER_ROLL at 60.0, a tilt of -60 to 60 degrees maps to a rate of -1.0 to 1.0,
; and the parameters below are multiplied by that rate to get the offset.
; The ROLL value is ignored.
; GERWALK mode (not locked on).
; Values for turning left.
; When turning right, the ROLL value is inverted.
; Battroid mode (not locked on).
; Fighter mode (locked on).
; The offset is computed from the positions of the unit and the target.
; It uses the angle of the target as seen from the unit, within the
; LOCKON_FIGHTER_PITCH_RANGE and LOCKON_FIGHTER_ROLL_RANGE of [BEHAVIOR_PARAM].
; (offset computed in that range)
; The ROLL value is ignored.
; GERWALK mode (locked on).
; Values for turning left.
; When turning right, EYE_X, TARGET_X and ROLL are inverted.
; Battroid mode (locked on, short range).
; Used when the distance to the target is LOCKON_BATTROID_SHORT or less.
; Battroid mode (locked on, mid range).
; Battroid mode (locked on, long range).
; Used when the distance to the target is LOCKON_BATTROID_LONG or more.
; While shooting down missiles.
; During an SP attack.
; Individual parameters.
;	BOOST_EYE_OFFSET_Z			Eye Z offset while boosting.
;	CHARGE_BOOST_EYE_OFFSET_Z	Eye Z offset during a Charge Boost.
;	BREAK_EYE_OFFSET_Z			Eye Z offset while braking.
;	FIGHTER_ROLL_RATE			Rate of camera Z rotation relative to the unit's tilt in Fighter mode.
;	FIGHTER_PITCH				Nose pitch range in Fighter mode (degrees).
;	FIGHTER_ROLL				Bank range in Fighter mode (degrees).
;	LOCKON_FIGHTER_PITCH		Nose pitch range in Fighter mode, locked on (degrees).
;	LOCKON_FIGHTER_ROLL			Bank range in Fighter mode, locked on (degrees).
;	LOCKON_BATTROID_SHORT		Switch distance for Battroid mode (locked on, short range).
;	LOCKON_BATTROID_LONG		Switch distance for Battroid mode (locked on, long range).
